adaptations: Doc Nexus replaces the upstream discovery stub with a platform workflow using the pinned image binary and system Chromium, without runtime package installation or browser downloads.

The image distributes the native binary, complete skill-data resources, upstream license and embedded axe-core third-party licenses under /usr/local/share/agent-browser. AGENT_BROWSER_SKILLS_DIR selects these read-only resources.
Admission remains an explicit, versioned SkillInstaller operation; readiness and authorized public-web use are distinct from static prompt-only skill approval.
